message.content: {"items":[{"title":"European Election Study 1989: Finland","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7762","justification":"Includes questions on transport and travel behavior (e.g., commuting, use of public transport) in Finland at the end of the 1980s; while later than the 1960s, it is one of the earliest GESIS-held Finnish datasets with explicit transport/travel content."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 32 (1989): Energy, Environment, and Safety of Transport – Finland subset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13287","justification":"Contains a dedicated module on safety of transport and transport modes. GESIS provides country-specific subsets including Finland; although from 1989, it is relevant for historical comparison and for studying transport attitudes near, but not within, the 1960s."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 38.1 (1992): Transport and Road Safety – Finland subset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10966","justification":"Focuses on transport modes, road safety, and travel behavior. GESIS allows extraction of data for Finland. The survey is early 1990s, not 1960s, but is among the earliest GESIS comparative surveys with detailed transport content including Finland."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 41.0 (1994): Transport – Finland subset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10969","justification":"This Eurobarometer wave concentrates on transport policy, use of different means of transport, and travel behavior. Finland is one of the participating countries; again, not from the 1960s but relevant for historical transport analyses."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 54.1 (2000): Transport and Tourism – Finland subset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3256","justification":"Contains modules on transport modes, mobility, and tourism-related travel. Finland is included in the country coverage. Useful for studying longer-term changes in transport and travel behavior despite post-1960s timing."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 62.2 (2004): Transport and Road Safety – Finland subset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.3264","justification":"Includes questions on frequency of using different transport modes, road safety perceptions, and travel patterns. Finland is included. Provides later historical reference on transport compared with the target 1960s decade."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 72.1 (2009): Transport, Road Safety, and Public Transport – Finland subset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10201","justification":"Offers detailed items on car use, public transport usage, and attitudes toward transport policy. Finland is one of the participating countries, allowing comparative study over time even though the fieldwork is much later than the 1960s."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 77.2 (2012): Transport and Tourism – Finland subset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11592","justification":"Covers mobility, transport infrastructure, choice of transport modes, and tourism-related travel behavior, with data available for Finland. Relevant for longitudinal analyses of transport and travel, though decades after the 1960s."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 82.2 (2014): Transport – Finland subset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12294","justification":"Focuses on transport services, public transport satisfaction, and mobility patterns. Finland is included; while not 1960s data, it is part of a time series for examining change in transport and travel attitudes."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 88.1 (2017): Road Safety and Autonomous Vehicles – Finland subset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12981","justification":"Includes questions on transport behavior, road safety, and new transport technologies. GESIS provides access including Finland. Again, not from the 1960s but among GESIS transport-related datasets that cover Finland."}]}
